findings.claim: A comment in tick() still describes the Phase 0 finish panel. Since B02, the results screen is what takes over once the player finishes. That is the same stale reference C013 fixed in CLAUDE.md, and it would send a feature night looking at the dead finish-panel.ts.
findings.evidence: src/game.ts:178 `// After the finish the player's car coasts; the panel takes over the controls. The bots drive on.` but src/game.ts:48 `/** Control surface used by the start screen, the results screen and src/driver (gates). */` and :325 `// ... if the player finishes, the results screen replaces the pause.` race-ui.ts shows createResultsScreen; nothing in src imports finish-panel.ts (C012).
findings.suggestedFix: Change 'the panel takes over the controls' to 'the results screen takes over the controls'. Only the comment changes.

confirmations.note: Still present, now 9 deep imports. props.ts:9 imports the bale/tyre constants from '../sim/track.ts', which sim/index.ts:5 doesn't export. types.ts imports are at props.ts:8, scene.ts:16, render/track.ts:5, race-ui.ts:5, format.ts:2, results-screen.ts:7, input/index.ts:3, plus a new one at ui/countdown.ts:5.

src/render/index.ts:5-9 still re-exports frameWidthFor, CameraRig, CarObject, DustPool, LIGHT_DIRECTION, TOON_STEPS, Materials, and all of line 9. A grep outside src/render finds no users. Keep countdownOffsetEast on line 5: tests/render/countdown-*.test.ts import it.
src/game.ts:31 `const MINIMAP_STRIDE = 8;` used at :279, while src/ui/stages/stage.ts:67 says 'every 8th centreline point, as in the game' and :72 has `centre.filter((_, i) => i % 8 === 0)`.

Partly fixed: the race-ui line now names the pause and results screens (C013). Still wrong: 'tracks, cars and screens register by being in their folder', when the roster is a hand-edited ROSTER (drivers.ts:12) and only tracks.ts and stages/registry.ts glob. Also the layout line 'tracks, cars, features', when src/content has only tracks/, tracks.ts and drivers.ts.

src/game.ts:188 `const view = raceView(r.world);` still runs in draw() on every animation frame, whether or not a tick ran. play() (:322) also builds a full raceView every tick just for countdownFraming, which only reads raceTick.
